description: Pub. 537 (2025), Example—Sale of a Business: the machine shop's building (selling price $48,000, selling expense $2,400, adjusted basis $36,000 after $9,000 straight-line depreciation, gain $9,600, no recapture). The installment part of the $100,000 down payment is $49,300 and 'Building—$9,600 ÷ $108,500 ... 8.85'; 'Building—8.85% of $49,300 ... 4,363'. With the printed 0.0885 (885) and the whole $49,300 the line 24 amount is $4,363.05, all of it unrecaptured § 1250 gain (total $9,000 = the depreciation).
